retained: The original analysis-only lavfi graph: 24 kHz, 1200-sample windows, eight octave-width bandpasses at 60/120/250/500/1000/2000/4000/8000 Hz.
Per-channel real RMS and peak metadata, bounded named log parsing and 128 timestamped samples per band; future and stale data cannot animate the current clock.
The original dB scales, nonlinear spectrum mapping, eight-percent idle height, 45 ms rise/180 ms fall, 80 ms opacity and 95 ms RMS transitions; technical axes remain LTR.
Meters stop consuming native analysis when hidden or inactive; reduced motion disables the spectrum animation.
mobileAdaptations: Profile-owned preferences control levels and spectrum. The compact dock reserves metadata space, with a larger spectrum available in the expanded player.
Shared leases and monotonic revisions prevent an old view from disabling a newer consumer or restarting a retired decoder.
Native event polling increases only while analysis has a consumer. System Now Playing clock publication remains bounded to five updates per second.
Artwork-derived color tuning, Miku/GIF modes and the complete DJ deck remain unfinished.
